accuracy_notes: Title plans were not represented as exact legal boundaries.
Online search copies were not represented as official proof of ownership.
General and determined boundaries were kept distinct.
INSPIRE polygons were treated as indicative freehold-index geometry rather than title plans.
No parcel ownership, exact legal boundary or Future Growth score was fabricated.
